concepts.gloss_en: Verse quote (Ps. 58:11) 'The righteous shall rejoice when he sees vengeance'

ישמח צדיק כי חזה נקם" וכו

reason_for_human: All four occurrences are the identical verse quotation from Psalms 58:11, vocalized the same way (יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק כִּי חָזָה נָקָם); the two 'forms' differ only by a stray quotation-mark character. This is a single quoted verse, not a homograph, so all merge into one concept.
